records.description: TD 63-73: Total Design and Its Pioneering Role in Graphic Design (Expanded Edition) / Available at www.draw-down.com / 520 pages! This book written by Ben Bos a key member of the Total Design studio describes how a band of idealistic Dutch designers came together to form one of the first multidisciplinary design groupsone that helped shape the future of design in Europe and beyond. Total Design began in Amsterdam in 1963 with Ben Bos joining founders Wim Crouwel Benno Wissing Friso Kramar and the Schwarz Brothers from the outset. Together and individually they set new benchmarks for typography identity design cultural design exhibition design and product design. This work is an expansion of Unit Edition's original 2011 publication and like the first edition provides an insiders account of Total Designs golden period. It contains hundreds of images from the TD archive and through Ben Boss text the reader is given a personal history of a design group that remains as important today as it did when it launched in 1963. This edition features an updated and extended text by Ben Bos that looks beyond 1973 as well as many previously unseen images from his personal archive. Published by Unit Editions 2015 Hardcover with slipcase 7.75  9.75 inches #graphicdesign #typography #totaldesign #uniteditions #BenBos #WimCrouwel #Amsterdam #design #designgroup by drawdownbooks

records.title: Silvia Sutters on Instagram: “Oh my! I can't wait to show you guys the block I've made for the @pbstudiofabrics new block hop. This is just a sneak peek, but I'll tell…”
records.description: Oh my! I can't wait to show you guys the block I've made for the @pbstudiofabrics new block hop. This is just a sneak peek but I'll tell you it's another crazy FPP because you know I can't just design a HST simple block and because I believe in designing what I like and not what's easy for someone else to make. Saawrry!  But let me clear things up because I know how our IG relationship is sensitive and we all take things personal I love HST's. This is not an attack on anyone. Some of my favorite designs are HST's. It's just that my mind doesn't think that way. That's all. Anyway let us be kind today and I hope you check my block at the end of the month. #ishouldvhavesavedthisforablogpost by astrangerview

records.description: Anti Riot police (CRS) during a tense facing with a group of migrants. Calais France. December 7 2015.  Shot by Jerome Sessini at the end of 2015 the Calais jungle is the name given to the shantytown near Calais city where migrants live while they attempt to enter the United Kingdom by stowing away on ferries cars or trains travelling through the Port of Calais or the Eurotunnel Calais Terminal. About 5 000 migrants were living in the Jungle of Calais at the time.  As the crossing to England became harder for the migrants confrontation with police happened more frequently.  #JeromeSessini/#MagnumPhotos by magnumphotos
